notes: 'of me' is read as part of Παύλου's own English expression, no source pronoun standing in the phrase for it to answer to.

s003 is unrepresented because the first-person possessive adjective ἐμῇ carries the possessive (rules 20 and 54); the head of that unit is 'mine', the word the corpus spends on ἐμός, with 'own' as its emphatic helper.
s005 keeps 'with' because the article's determiner slot is displaced, so nothing anchors the case preposition on the article (rule 21).
